title: Revision rota: Al-Jinn to Al-Muddaththir: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 47 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Revision rota rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 47. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ (١) قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا (٢) نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا (٣) أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا (٤) إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا (٥) إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا (٦)

keywords.def: older hifdh revised on a rota

questions.q: Chain recitation: Al-Muddaththir 1 to 20, one ayah per pupil.
Rota: today's group recites two of 72 to 74 to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link weak passages; pupils still learning 72 or 73 work on their next block.
Which surah tells us to 'recite the Qur'an with measured recitation'?
Think again: Al-Jinn and Al-Muzzammil were Autumn targets. Which of 72 to 74 needs most work for you, and how will you fix it?
questions.a: Each pupil names one and plans daily 3-3-link repair.
